One of the best and jaw dropping performance by Zendaya

Zendaya revolutionized her career and television history by winning the 2020 Primetime Emmy for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series at age 24, becoming the youngest winner ever for her raw, acclaimed portrayal of Rue Bennett in Euphoria. She later became the youngest two-time winner in 2022, securing her place as a premier talent.

Euphoria Season 3 officially premieres on April 12, 2026, on HBO and Max, following a four-year hiatus. The new season is set to jump forward in time, following the group as they navigate the "virtue of faith and the possibility of redemption" outside the halls of East Highland.
